subject: maths
question: Suresh invested a certain sum of money at 5% per annum simple interest. If he receives an interest of ₹69687 after 15 year, the sum (in ₹) he invested is:
solution:
**Given:**

Interest (I) = ₹69687

Rate (R) = 5% per annum

Time (T) = 15 years

**Formula used:**

I = P × R × T / 100

Where, P = Principal

**Calculation:**

69687 = P × 5 × 15 / 100

⇒ 69687 = P × 75 / 100

⇒ P = 69687 × 100 / 75

⇒ P = 6968700 / 75

⇒ P = 92916

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
